in_sanskrit.name: Kunjarajan

in_tamil.name: கதிரவன்
in_tamil.meaning: the one who shines like the sun
in_tamil.long_meaning: கதிர் (kathir) - shining, sun; வன் (van) - one who possesses

in_marathi.name: Kathiravan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Shining like the sun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kathiravan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kathiravan is the name of a prince from Tamil mythology, who was sent by his father, Lord Indra, to rescue his wife, Mohini, from the demon king Iravadhaman. The name 'Kathiravan' means 'shining like the sun' or 'rays ofof.sun'.
